title: Retain rules in nested declarations
author: mischnic
summary: When a style rule has nested rules, logical-property (and :dir/supports/dark) fallback rules generated while minifying get lost because the child handler context is discarded; the PR merges the child context back into the parent. Data loss bug hit by Tailwind + daisyUI (Next.js issue), PR by a team member.
evidence: master 574eee2 CLI --targets 'chrome 80' on `.btn1{:where(&){width:unset} border-start-start-radius:10px}` outputs only `:where(.btn1){width:unset}` followed by blank lines; the border radius is silently dropped. #1049 has 8 reactions, labelled bug. No reviews yet. Review: the expected output in the new prefix_test ends with extra blank lines (empty rule printed?), and whether merging the child context could attach nested-rule logical rules to the parent selector.
